topics.topic: RuntimeSettings startup environment variables and missing-value behavior
questions: Which complete set of environment variables is loaded at startup, and for each one is absence rejected, defaulted, or accepted as unavailable?

quotes:
`config.runtime_environment_variables`: the closed table of environment
  variables, their types, requiredness, normalization and per-environment
  defaults, read into `RuntimeSettings` (R0-10; Factory `a6916180314d`,
  `51d19fdf`).

`capability:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings` reads and validates the
   environment variables of A30; a missing, malformed or inconsistent one (a
   wildcard host or origin, binary bounds out of order) stops the start
   before any request is served. The Registry endpoint is not one of them:
   the service starts without it (A6).
judgement.why: The complete RuntimeSettings field set and each environment variable's requiredness and default are configuration/model-contract details owned by State 6, not a missing State 4 owner, failure outcome, or module operation.
